ARPR.description: Area Pressure Load (ARPR). The TYPE field selects how ELEM_LISTS is interpreted: TYPE=GROUP treats ELEM_LISTS[0] as a plane/area group key, while TYPE=ELEMENT treats ELEM_LISTS as the list of element keys.

DIRECTION.description: Loading direction. Case-insensitive. NORMAL = normal to the area; GX/GY/GZ = global axis directions; VECTOR = direction given by VECTOR_ARRAY.

INNER_POINTS.description: Inner reference point [X, Y, Z] used to define the loaded area.

VECTOR_ARRAY.description: Direction vector [X, Y, Z]. Used to define the load direction when DIRECTION=VECTOR.

ELEM_LISTS.description: [TYPE=GROUP] first element is the plane/area group key (only ELEM_LISTS[0] is used). [TYPE=ELEMENT] full list of element keys the pressure applies to.

bPROJECTION.description: Projection flag. true applies the pressure on the projected area.

TYPE.description: Selection type. Case-insensitive. GROUP = ELEM_LISTS[0] is an area/plane group key; ELEMENT = ELEM_LISTS is a list of element keys.

GROUP_NAME.description: Load group name. Empty string means no load group; a non-empty name must reference an existing load group.
